note: MEASUREMENT POOLS. An independent provenance axis for experiments that MEASURE A MODEL POOL rather than instantiate an Arena roster. This axis and population_regime_id are mutually exclusive and never infer one another: a pool is what gets loaded and measured, a regime is who debates. Conflating them produced finding REGIME-1.
